top_signals.title: Investors See 10-Year Treasury Yields at 5% Hurting EM Asia Debt
top_signals.summary: Global funds see any rise in Treasury 10-year yields toward 5% spurring outflows from emerging Asian bonds, as higher rates in the US will prompt investors to favor dollar assets over regional debt.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US-Canada Trade Draft Piles Pressure on Mexico to Match Terms
top_signals.summary: Canada’s preliminary trade deal with the US caught Mexican officials and business leaders off guard. Now, Mexico wants one of its own, as questions grow over whether months of painstaking engagement can deliver comparable tariff relief from President Donald Trump.

top_signals.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
top_signals.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
